title: Clean Now: Storage Cleaner
summary: AI phone cleaner for deleting duplicated photos, videos, files, apps & contacts.
description:
Clean Now: Storage Cleaner is a smart cleaning app that helps you organize your phone, remove unwanted items, and free up storage in a simple way. Clean photos, videos, files, apps, contacts, and calendar events from one easy-to-use tool.

With Clean Now: Storage Cleaner, you can quickly review what takes up space on your device and decide what to keep or delete. The app is designed to make phone cleanup faster, safer, and easier for everyday use.

Photo and Video Cleaner



Find and delete unwanted photos and videos from your device. Review similar photos, duplicate images, screenshots, large videos, and unnecessary media files before removing them.

The cleaner helps you organize your gallery and reduce storage clutter without deleting important memories by mistake.

File Cleaner



Manage and delete files that are no longer needed. Browse documents, downloads, large files, and other stored items to quickly clean up space.

Phone Cleaner makes it easier to find hidden storage clutter and remove unnecessary files in just a few steps.

App Cleaner and App Manager



Check installed apps and identify apps you no longer use. Review app information and remove unnecessary apps to keep your phone cleaner and more organized.

This feature is useful when your device has too many apps or when you want to reduce storage usage quickly.

Contact Cleaner



Clean and organize your contacts with simple tools. Find duplicate contacts, incomplete contacts, and outdated entries, then merge or delete them when needed.

Keep your contact list clear, accurate, and easier to manage.

Calendar Cleaner



Remove old, unnecessary, or duplicate calendar events. Clean up outdated schedules and keep your calendar more organized.

This helps reduce digital clutter and makes your calendar easier to browse.

Smart Cleanup Tools



Clean Now: Storage Cleaner gives you useful tools to manage different types of phone data in one place. Instead of checking photos, videos, files, apps, contacts, and calendar events separately, you can handle phone cleanup from a single app.

Key Features




  • Photo cleaner for unwanted images, screenshots, and similar photos

  • Video cleaner for large and unnecessary videos

  • File cleaner for documents, downloads, and storage clutter

  • App cleaner to review and remove unused apps

  • Contact cleaner to find duplicates and incomplete contacts

  • Calendar cleaner to remove old or duplicate events

  • Simple interface for quick phone cleanup

  • Storage management tools for everyday use



Keep Your Phone Clean and Organized



Over time, phones collect duplicate photos, large videos, unused apps, old files, messy contacts, and outdated calendar events. Clean Now: Storage Cleaner helps you review and remove these items so your device stays easier to manage.

Download Clean Now: Storage Cleaner and start cleaning your photos, videos, files, apps, contacts, and calendar in one simple app.
